description:
`descend_quadratic_runtime` and `descend_cubic_runtime` in `crates/gf2-core/src/field/extension_wiedemann.rs` lift a base coefficient with zero higher components and then check that those components are zero, so the guard passes for every input. The helper `runtime_descent_synthetic_alpha_test` asserts only properties of elements it constructs itself. The defect is reported from reading the code and is unconfirmed by a failing test.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each descent function returns an error for an element with a nonzero higher component, covered by a test that passes such an element.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each descent function returns the base element for an element of the base field, covered by a test whose inputs come from the public extension API.
title: Runtime extension descent guard cannot reject a non-base element
